post_hoc_scorer_audit.finding: Both mechanically unsupported full-context findings were requirement-grounded empty-root or fail-closed findings, not hallucinations.
post_hoc_scorer_audit.cause: The frozen lexical scorer omitted empty-root language and required deny, exception, or fail-closed wording rather than semantically equivalent rejected or raise wording.
post_hoc_scorer_audit.implication: Treat the one 0.75 full-context recall score and the two unsupported counts as conservative lexical-scoring artifacts.

interpretation: Compact claim-capsule transport preserved observed critic quality on these two candidates while cutting explicit prompt bytes by 56.1 percent. Provider-reported input fell only 7.0 percent, indicating that fixed CLI and model context dominates the payload savings. Compact critics were slower by 8.0 to 14.2 percent on the stratified medians.
limitations: Two synthetic candidates and three repeats per arm are not enough for a general quality claim.
Only Codex gpt-6-sol at low critic effort was tested.
The deterministic scorer is intentionally frozen but lexically brittle.
Provider-reported input includes fixed context outside the explicit experiment prompt.
Completion timing includes one 44.9 second compact outlier and uncontrolled service variance.
